origin.summary: Workout 3 of the 2016 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A 7-minute AMRAP of power snatches and bar muscle-ups.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2016/3 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
